summary: Remove lowest importance stance and common opponent features to reduce overfitting
rationale: Diagnostics show southpaw_vs_southpaw (importance 1), orthodox_vs_orthodox (importance 2), and num_common_opponents (importance 1) have near-zero importance. These binary stance matchup features add noise without meaningful predictive value. The model shows severe overfitting with an 8% train-validation gap (70.77% vs 62.90%). Removing these low-importance features should reduce overfitting and improve Top 25% generalization by eliminating noise in the feature space.
expected_effect: Expected to reduce overfitting and improve Top 25% confidence accuracy by removing noise features. The train-validation gap should decrease as the model focuses on more predictive signals. Underdog performance may also benefit from cleaner feature representation.
